name: refactor_shortlink_shared_error_responses
description: L3 repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): extract the six inline JSON error responses across three routers into one sendError helper; drift broken changes the body key
prompts: In this express-ts-shortlink repo, the three routers (src/routes/links.ts, redirect.ts, stats.ts) hand-build every JSON error response inline - `res.status(...).json({ error: ... })` appears six times with the same shape. Extract that into one helper: create src/routes/respond.ts exporting sendError(res, status, message) that sends { error: message } with the given status, and replace ALL inline error responses in the three routers with calls to it (success responses stay as they are). Pure refactor: every status code and every error body must stay byte-identical - the response key stays `error` and the messages stay exactly 'link not found', 'url is required', 'invalid slug', and 'slug already taken'. Everything must still compile under `tsc -p .` strict.
